text: In the act of giving, feel how you are receiving, and in the act of receiving - how you are giving. When you give something, focus on what you are receiving at that moment: the other person’s joy, a sense of your own fullness, the opportunity to manifest love. When you receive a gift, focus on what you are giving in return: the opportunity to experience generosity, to manifest your best qualities... It is important not to invent, but to be aware of what is actually happening - your feelings will tell you. In different situations with different people, you will notice something new. This practice will open to you a different understanding of human relationships and free you from a number of stereotypes that currently control you.
